result.brief: 提出域不变场景表征 DISR 作为未来预测目标，结合视觉语言理解、潜在世界建模与流匹配动作专家，从自我中心网络视频迁移人类导航经验到四足机器人。
result.reason: Proposes domain-invariant scene representation (DISR) as future-prediction target, outperforming five generic visual representations; also latent world modeling with flow-matching action expert for quadruped navigation.
